P.name: Reign of Anger
P.title: Template:Data Renekton/Reign of Anger
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Reign of Anger|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Renekton |skill = I |icon = Reign of Anger.png |blurb = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Renekton}} {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability}} hits generate {{as|{{tip|Fury}}}}, which continually expires after a period without fighting. He generates {{as|'''bonus''' Fury}} while {{as|'''below''' half health}}. |blurb2 = While '''Renekton''' has at least {{as|50% Fury}}, his next basic ability consumes {{as|50% Fury}} to become empowered with an additional effect. |description = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Renekton's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate {{tip|fury|{{as|5 Fury}}}} {{tip|on-hit}}. After 12 seconds of being out of combat and not basic attacking, he loses {{as|1 Fury}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

Entering combat or using an attack will stop the {{as|Fury}} loss and refresh the timer. Additionally, while ''{{ai|Dominus|Renekton}}'' is active, the timer is continuously refreshed. |description2 = While '''Renekton''' has at least {{as|50 Fury}}, his next {{tip|ability|basic ability}}, excluding ''{{ai|Slice and Dice|Renekton|Slice}}'', consumes {{as|50 Fury}} to become empowered with an additional effect. Empowered abilities do not generate {{as|Fury}}. |description3 = '''Renekton''' generates {{as|50% '''bonus''' Fury}} from all sources while {{as|below 50% of his '''maximum''' health}}. |targeting = Passive |affects = Self |parry = unknown |damagetype = |spellshield = |spelleffects = |projectile = |notes = * Basic attacks against any enemy that is not a structure will generate the Fury. ** '''Renekton''' can generate Fury by collecting {{ui|Honeyfruit}} and [[Health Relic]]s (interacts with ''Reign of Anger's'' bonus generation). * {{Pending for test}} Fury generation with parrying effects ({{tip|blind}}, {{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}}) }}

W.name: Ruthless Predator
W.title: Template:Data Renekton/Ruthless Predator
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Ruthless Predator|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Renekton
|skill        = W
|icon         = Ruthless Predator.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{cis|Renekton}} next basic attack within a few seconds will strike twice, dealing {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} and briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} the target.
|blurb4      = {{sbc|{{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton}} Bonus:}} '''Renekton''' instead strikes 3 times with increased stun duration, destroying damage {{tip|shields}} on the target before dealing damage.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renekton''' empowers his next basic attack within 7 seconds to have a {{tt|{{fd|0.2}}-second cast time|(Estimated)}}, have {{sti|range|175 range}} and strike the target twice, dealing {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds. Each strike applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and generates {{tip|fury|{{as|Fury}}}}. Hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} generates {{as|10 '''bonus''' Fury}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|5*2 to 65*2}} {{as|(+ 150% AD)}}|Physical Damage Per Hit|{{ap|5 to 65}} {{as|(+ 75% AD)}}}}
|description2 = ''Ruthless Predator's'' first strike can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Renekton|crit_base}}|100|base=100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
|description3 = {{sbc|{{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton}} Bonus:}} '''Renekton''' instead strikes 3 times, completely destroying damage-mitigating {{tip|shield|shields}} on the target upon the first strike if they are not a {{tip|monster}}, as well as increasing the {{tip|stun}} duration to {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
|leveling3    = {{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|5*3 to 65*3}} {{as|(+ 225% AD)}}}}
|description4 = ''Ruthless Predator {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Renekton's''' basic attack timer. After Ruthless Predator's standard and empowered attack cast time, '''Renekton''' cannot move nor cast {{ai|Cull the Meek|Renekton}} or {{ai|Slice and Dice|Renekton}} for {{rutngt|0.525}}. Casting {{ai|Dominus|Renekton}} ends this lockout prematurely.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|16 to 8}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cast time    = none
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Enemies / Self
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Special
|projectile   = 
|parry        = True
|notes        =  
* Each strike of ''Ruthless Predator'' deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but the first strike also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.
* If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}} or {{tip|death|dies}} during the empowered attack's cast time, it is cancelled but not consumed.
* Each strike of ''Ruthless Predator'' counts as a separate {{tip|cast instance}} for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}} and {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}}.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}}.
* The first two attacks of the {{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton|empowered}} version will generate fury.{{bug}}
** The third attack will remove any fury gained since the first attack.
*** This includes fury generated via {{ai|Dominus|Renekton}}.{{bug}}
*** This will fail to remove fury gained through a {{iis|Guinsoo's Rageblade}} {{nie|Phantom Hit}} which has triggered on the first attack.{{bug}}
**** This will '''not''' fail to remove fury gained through {{iis|Dusk and Dawn}} {{nie|Spellblade}}.
* Even if empowered ''Ruthless Predator'' is blocked by a {{tip|spell shield}}, it will still destroy any existing damage {{tip|shield|shields}} on the target.
* ''Ruthless Predator'' does not cause '''Renekton''' to attack twice/thrice. Effects that trigger {{tip|on-attack}} or interact with the attack windup will only trigger once and thus do not interact with ''Ruthless Predator''. (e.g. {{ri|Lethal Tempo}}, {{ri|Hail of Blades}}).
}}
